en: Hey!  Get away from that!
You seek to lower our global defenses in order to appease a paranoid magistrate and an encampment of riff-raff that are most probably suffering from heat stroke.
You've been summoned by Lago Blackwrench, warlock master of Ironforge. You'd do yourself well to report to him immediately. You'll find him in the Forlorn Cavern district of the city.
What else do you have to say?
I shall wear your entrails as a necklace.
Malton, you dummy!
Help! Get this $n off of me!
Where can I go to improve my lockpicking?
These are fine pieces, $n.  Let me get started on your robe.
Faire's a coming!

It is history... A history of Silithus... of Ahn'Qiraj... of Titans and Old Gods... I read from the prophecy of C'Thun as written by the Qiraji Prophet Skerram. A prophecy that portends a cataclysm...
Greetings, $r. Wonderful day to be alive, is it not?
The Kolkar are the strongest!
You won't ruin my lands, you scum!
How many more supplies are needed to send a ground assault?
The Signet of Chaos belongs to Ravenholdt, beast! You will never hold its power! (PLACEHOLDER - TO BE MOVED/CHANGED)
$n claims the stables!  If left unchallenged, the Alliance will control it in 1 minute!
How has this come to be, $n? Do you think that an item such as the Scepter of Celebras is trivial?$B$BI can help you this time, but do not be careless with this valuable item again...
Bad, $n. $n, bad!
Not too clever are you?  Hmm, if I were a stable master perhaps I might be in the vicinity of say, the stable?  Look for Morganus over there.

The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, $n.$B$BIt must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds in the next age of your people.$B$BWhen you are prepared to ring the Scarab Gong and once more open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj, I will grant you the Scepter. You have only to ask.

Please, please, please tell me you are here to get me out of these shackles.  There's got to be a key somewhere...$B$BAt the very least, maybe you can take out Guard Slip'kik.  I think I might be able to help you out!$B$BSee that broken trap over yonder?  The ogres are too stupid to figure out how to fix it.  Clearly, it needs a thorium widget and some frost oil.  If you fix it, I bet you could lure Slip'kik into it, and BLAMMO - trapped ogre guard!
I have lost my Dagger of Veiled Shadows. Are you able to replace it for me?
Elder Nightwind passes the days at the shrine in Jaedenar in Felwood.
I would like to buy from you.
If you need training in alchemy, there is only one place in Stormwind you need to go... Alchemy Needs. You can find it in the Mage Quarter along the outer rim of shops.
Okay, okay! No need to get all violent. I'll talk. I'll talk!
And I wish I could join you $n. Head over to Stormwind Keep. You'll find Thelman Slatefist in the King's audience chamber. He will aid you in getting to Alterac Valley.
Only $3658E shopping minutes before Christmas!  But wait, is it Christmas?  Well then, there are only $3659E minutes left to party!  TEST TEST DO NOT LOCALIZE
Hm, these are pretty good bones you got this time, Pozzik.
Why have you summoned me so soon?  I haven't yet reached my full power!
Falthir, I need assistance in recovering a piece of my Madcap's Outfit.
If you could catch a fish big enough for your mouth we'd never be hungry again.
A bow is a great ting ma friend. Joo jus have to take care of it, and it will take care of joo.
Items of antiquity, weapons of war, armor or rarity. Who knows what Antonio will be carrying this week if you do not come look.
This moon beam will send you to Orgrimmar.  Use your invitation when you want to go.

May Cenarius guide you, $c.$B$BI am here in this corrupt land with my sisters on a mission of great importance to the Cenarian Circle. But only those who are powerful enough I ask speak to me about such matters--to send a lesser being would be folly.
Yes I checked, I'm missing the top piece!
Okay... so you wanna' be a tailor. How about you prove it?
I've done it! I have harnessed the power of the stone into the goggles! Let's get out of here!
As deadly as the silithid seem, they are but tame creatures compared to their Qiraji overlords.
As if I don't have better things to do in my old age than carry buckets of water.
We Timbermaw can grant you safe passage through the hold, however, you must prove yourself worthy of our aid.

It pleases me greatly to at last meet one of your people. I've heard much of the shen'dorei and your long history, and  I am glad to see our cousins return home to Kalimdor at long last.

I confess that our people have a... complicated relationship with the Highborne. Some amongst the Night Elves are quick to distrust those of Highborne descent such as those in your High Order. However, you have my assurance that you will be shown the utmost respect while a guest in our city.

Please, make yourself at home here. I'd encourage you to explore and familiarize yourself with our culture. It is, after all, your culture as well in a way.
The Snowfall Graveyard was taken by the Horde!
Leave no survivors!
